sources.title: Isabelle AFP Stern_Brocot_Tree — mk_path and stern_brocot_rationals theorem
sources.attested: Unique exact positive rational is reached by left/right subtractive Euclidean path, root 1/1; formal proof of completeness and non-repetition.

sources.title: Milad Niqui, Exact arithmetic on the Stern-Brocot tree, Journal of Discrete Algorithms 5, 356–379 (2007)
sources.attested: Tree-path representations support exact computation with rational numbers, not an FPGA-specific transport scheme.

sources.title: Owner spanda original E-P Dance exact p/q / FPGA / analog triangle
sources.attested: Owner names Stern–Brocot / continued fractions as a route to exact p/q from observed analog values; motivation only, not pre-existing implementation of this particular path codec.

attribution_limit: Formal AFP describes uncompressed L/R mk_path and tree theorems. Batched positive run lengths, compact structure, strict exact-bit representation and explicit error behavior are a new proposed SENS data law, not attributed to the 19th century or to FPGA protocol.

candidate.domain: exact positive rational p/q (p>0,q>0, gcd normalized), not floats or physical voltages
candidate.result: canonical alternating sequence of (D1 predicate bit, positive integer count) where bit 0=LEFT below current Stern–Brocot node and bit 1=RIGHT above current node; 1/1 maps to empty run sequence
candidate.reverse: from a canonical run sequence, recover the original exact positive rational by left/right bounding-fraction mediants in O(number of runs), without expanding large counts
candidate.law: Generate exact L/R path from root 1/1 by repeated numerator/denominator comparison and subtractive Euclid; compress maximal same-bit runs using quotient floor((a-1)/b) or floor((b-1)/a), preserving final equality stop without one extra step. Reject nonpositive and imprecise source inputs; reverse accepts ONLY alternating positive-length bit runs. Two-direction round trips are identity and representation is unique for every positive rational.

positives.note: exact run compression from Euclid, final right run of 3
billion path steps represented by one positive run
unbounded integer width, no bit expansion

falsifiers: For 3/1, returning right-run count 3 rather than 2 introduces an extra branch past the exact rational.
For 1/1, returning any left or right step is not the root path.
For 5/2, reversing R² L into L R² reaches a different fraction.
Consecutive same-direction run records must reject rather than silently admit a noncanonical alternative code.
Zero/negative run counts, boolean bits, floats and nonpositive input rationals must reject.
A billion left steps must remain a run count, not allocate a billion-element bit sequence.
Turning the path into the nearest denominator-bounded fraction instead of exactly reversible p/q changes the mathematical meaning.

hobbies: SDR and acoustics periodic rational cadence
candidate.derivability: Euclid and exact rational arithmetic suffice to define this as a derived procedure; uniqueness and compact exact structure do NOT prove that a new irreducible evaluator primitive is required. Owner decides D10 research selection vs Core-Math library.
semantic_boundaries: Research bit is a D1 value and count is arbitrary exact positive integer; it is NOT a T5 word framing byte.
No D2 syntax/control or D7 text alphabet reuse.
No actual analog sensor calibration or FPGA map is implied.
Input positive exact rational only, NOT 0/1 or infinity/1 boundary sentinels.
